How To Read A Reifier A statement reifier names a quoted base triple and carries metadata such as [`gmeow:confidence`](../reference/properties/gmeow-confidence.md), [`gmeow:accordingTo`](../reference/properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md), [`gmeow:validFrom`](../reference/properties/gmeow-validFrom.md), and [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](../reference/properties/gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md). The metadata qualifies the statement, not the subject or object globally.
